d:
New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani used his office's Diwali celebration to speak out against rising racism targeting Indian-Americans, Hindus and Sikhs. Invoking the Ramayana and Mahabharata, he reflected on duty and moral responsibility. His remarks come amid a Seattle Diwali disruption and calls for a federal investigation into possible hate crime. Gursshheen Gahllen brings you the story on Firstpost America.
